summary_md: **Mistral AI ([@MistralAI](https://x.com/MistralAI/status/2115443720371814478))** introduces the **Responses API** in public preview for building agents on Mistral: each response returns the answer, reasoning and tool calls as separate items, for all hosted chat models including Large 4. The self-thread adds that Mistral now serves DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (preview) and GLM 5.3 Flash (GA) for coding and subagent work, and links the docs.
relevance: Another major vendor adopting a Responses-style agent API, plus hosted open models for subagents.

media.description: Mistral announcement card 'Responses API now in public preview' with a Python snippet creating a Mistral client and calling client.responses.create with model 'zai-glm-5-3-flash' and a one-sentence greeting prompt.
media.ocr_text:
Responses API now in public preview
from mistralai.client import Mistral
client = Mistral(api_key=os.environ["MISTRAL_API_KEY"])
response = client.responses.create(
    model="zai-glm-5-3-flash",
    input="Write a one-sentence greeting.",
)
